calibrationDefinition.outer: a.risk forecast of any future viability breach within 24 ticks
calibrationDefinition.inner: b.request score for positive 12-tick no-followup repair advantage
calibrationDefinition.valueUtility: integrity benefit − 0.1 × energy cost − 0.2 × material cost

cautions: Scores were not fitted as probabilities; this is a falsification of their calibration
Inner utility labels are branch-based diagnostics and only sampled at physically eligible moments
Paired counterfactual branches share deterministic simulator; they are not independent evidence
No weights changed; no policy promoted
interpretation: Raw recurrent a.risk and b.request are not calibrated probabilities. A low-risk threshold of 0.35 missed no positives in this cohort, but high expected calibration errors and adverse repair-value labels preclude trust or policy promotion.
